assertion_analysis.failure_condition: None: the shuffled recall is band draw index 0 of the same sample, so the inside-band assertion is true for any input and reddens on no regression.

findings.text: blocking: 19 of the 737 name golden rows (6 of them defects) have no frozen answer and are never judged, so each is scored on the single redundant_repeated_segment audit bit (risk 0.0 for 17 rows, 1.0 for 2); the brief directs the node to fill that gap by asking Jev, spend was USD 0.017 of a USD 0.50 ceiling, and the counts paragraph reports only the 718 reused rows and never the 19 left unjudged, so the composite's coverage is overstated.

blocking: the declared negative control is tautological — shuffle() draws its single permutation with random.Random(SHUFFLE_SEED) (run.py:47,696) while _shuffled_draws seeds its band draws with SHUFFLE_SEED+draw (run.py:409-417), so the shuffled recall is literally band draw index 0; the point is a member of the band sample, so inside is true for any input and the control cannot show the scorer reads the labels.

follow-on: _defect_probability's dimension branch and the _DOCS_DIMENSION_CRITERIA import are dead — no call site (run.py:139,335) passes dimension — yet ssog-risk-order.html:665-667 states the method includes 'one minus a dimension rubric's acceptable level, or one when an audit finding class is present', so the documented method differs from the one executed.

follow-on: the counts paragraph reports only the name-axis excluded audit checks (_name_items, run.py:162-168); the documentation axis silently drops claim_contradicts_source (run.py:333-334), the contradiction veto that jev_review.py:751-756 treats as overriding, and the dimension questions, so a reader cannot tell the docs composite omits them.

follow-on: the two name splits record incumbent recall as 0.000 while the HTML renders '—', because the committed JSON holds 0.0 for an incumbent order that has no members (incumbent_missing 380 of 380); the committed run.py:463-464 would write NaN for that case, so the committed results.json is not reproducible from the committed code and its 0.000 reads as 'the incumbent found no defects' rather than 'no incumbent scores exist'.

follow-on: bootstrap_interval owns copy-group-aware resampling for this repository, and ssog-risk-order-run.py:420-441 _copy_group_bootstrap re-implements that resampling loop (group indices, rng draws, percentiles) around a recall statistic rather than extending the owner with a pluggable statistic.
